# WO-181: Verify profile-scoped CLI read output
Status: open (ready; worktree pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: app-features
Owner contact: Nora Bennett (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3
Source: app/CLI coverage gap confirmed in read-only review; issued by the project owner on 2026-11-08

## Goal
Add test-only coverage that `status`, `todo list`, and `report` honor an explicitly selected profile and do not include another fake profile's records. Existing CLI tests cover multi-profile status and report output but do not verify exclusion for these selected-profile reads.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Use the existing in-process Typer/Click runner and temporary/fake store fixtures. Create two obviously fake profiles with distinct labels, statuses, and to-dos.
- For `status --profile` (and `status --json`), assert only the selected profile's records are shown and the other profile's label/data are absent.
- For `todo list --profile ... --json`, assert only the selected profile's to-dos appear.
- For `report --profile ... --json`, monkeypatch the report builder and assert it is called only for the selected profile; write no actual report file.
- Include only checks needed for the profile-isolation contract; do not test consent, practice mode, sending, outbox, or the unscoped `outbox list` command.
- If a real implementation defect appears, do not edit `src/`; mark only the affected assertion with a strict xfail and source file:line, and report the safe fake-data reproduction to Nora for an in-house SUM/SEC decision. No xfail is expected if the behavior is correct.
- Run `PYTHONPATH=src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_cli_profile_scoping.py` and `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_cli_profile_scoping.py` from the prepared worktree; record exact results in its `VENDOR_STATUS.md`.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `tests/codex/test_cx_cli_profile_scoping.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No `src/` edits, existing-test edits, user data, store/keyring/mailbox/network access, consent or practice-mode assertions, email submission, outbox behavior, package/config changes, or real report generation. Use only temporary fake data.

## Check-in plan
Start after `.vendor-wt/wo-181` is prepared on `vendor/wo-181`. Report progress and completion in the worktree status file and issue #150. Nora summarizes in `docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md`.

## Notes and decisions
- Read commands under test are `status`, `todo list`, and `report`; `outbox list` is intentionally unscoped and excluded.
